[SWS_CM_11411] Deserializing incomplete data on the skeleton side
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈
If less data than expected shall be de-serialized on the skeleton side the data shall be
discarded. In case of a received REQUEST message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]),
additionally, an ERROR message with return code set to
E_MALFORMED_MESSAGE
(see [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) shall be sent to the requester.
⌋
